title: Where Will the International Space Station Crash in 2030?
description:
Where Will the International Space Station Crash in 2030?

The International Space Station spans 109 metres end to end—the size of an American football field. After operations conclude around 2030, most of it will vaporise on re-entry while a deorbit spacecraft steers the surviving pieces into an uninhabited region of the ocean.

Sources: NASA International Space Station Facts & Transition Plan FAQ (109 m / 356 ft end-to-end, American football field; operates through 2030; U.S. Deorbit Vehicle targets an uninhabited ocean area; orbits over 90% of Earth's population).
https://www.nasa.gov/international-space-station/space-station-facts-and-figures/
https://www.nasa.gov/faqs-the-international-space-station-transition-plan/

Pictures: NASA imagery alongside our own animated graphics. Facts: every number is checked against the sources above.
Image credits: NASA; ESA.
